target.title: ci(apple-i18n): accept the direct localizing accessibilityLabel overload in the wrapper contract
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`main` is red: the `checks-node-compact-small-2` shard fails on every commit and PR merge ref because `test/scripts/apple-app-i18n.test.ts` requires the literal `.accessibilityLabel(Text(title))` in `apps/ios/Sources/Design/SettingsProTabSections.swift`, and a recent iOS landing (5e9bc0916f9) rewrote those call sites to `.accessibilityLabel(title)`.

## Why This Change Was Made

The Swift change is correct — `title` is `LocalizedStringKey` there (enforced by the same contract table), and SwiftUI's `accessibilityLabel(_:)` has a `LocalizedStringKey` overload that localizes directly, so wrapping in `Text(...)` is equivalent but unnecessary. The stale piece is the gate's literal: this updates the wrapper contract to the new form and keeps `.accessibilityLabel(Text(placeholder))`, which the file still uses.

## User Impact

None at runtime. Unblocks CI for all pending PRs.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs test/scripts/apple-app-i18n.test.ts` fails on plain `main` with "bypasses localized string lookup: .accessibilityLabel(Text(title))" and passes 13/13 with this change.
- `toggleCard(title: LocalizedStringKey ...)` / `aboutLinkRow(... LocalizedStringKey ...)` remain contract-enforced, so the localizing overload is guaranteed at those call sites.
